attackers_goals: An adversary may enumerate different protocols to gain information and plan its lateral movement over the network.
description: The endpoint performed unfamiliar RPC activity to multiple hosts using a known sensitive interface.
investigative_actions: Check if the host is a newly deployed server that provides RPC based services to multiple hosts. Verify the legitimacy of the actor process (and its causality) that initiated this RPC traffic.
name: Abnormal sensitive RPC traffic to multiple hosts
required_data: Palo Alto Networks Firewall EAL Logs
XDR Agent with eXtended Threat Hunting (XTH)
